stories.title: OpenAI announces three big science discoveries and a new way to work with academics
stories.explanation: OpenAI announced three new scientific discoveries in math, computer science, and physics, including proving the Exponential Time Hypothesis is false. The company also introduced a new method for working with academics, involving external experts guiding the release of results.

stories.title: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals What’s Under the Hood
stories.explanation: Anthropic filed its S-1 prospectus for an initial public offering, revealing financial details, risk factors, and its views on AI's future. The company plans to go public on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ANT, with revenue growing to over $16 billion through the first half of 2026.

stories.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
stories.explanation: OpenAI is sharing new model results in mathematics, computer science, and physics, and is experimenting with a new approach to work with academic communities to build scientific understanding. This initiative aims to allow researchers to verify and build on these AI-generated discoveries.

stories.title: Apple is adding an AI chatbot to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers
stories.explanation: Apple is adding an AI assistant, built on AI models from Apple and OpenAI, to its Pages, Keynote, and Numbers apps. This assistant can understand document context to draft, restructure, and refine content, as well as organize data.

stories.title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
stories.explanation: General Compute has raised $100 million in Series A funding, betting on inference chips from outside the Nvidia ecosystem. The company aims to provide computing power for AI, countering concerns about the neocloud market.

stories.title: Apple releases iOS and macOS 27.2 with new Siri AI features, new Music logo
stories.explanation: Apple released iOS and macOS 27.2, which includes new Siri AI features such as a memory function to recall past conversations and expanded data source access. Users can now also limit which applications Siri can access.

stories.title: Announcing Azure AI Speech LLM 09-2026: Broader locale support
stories.explanation: Microsoft is announcing Azure AI Speech LLM 09-2026, which expands multilingual language and locale support to 25 new languages and improves transcription speed. This enhancement aims to make multilingual workflows faster and more accurate for various applications.

stories.title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
stories.explanation: Opera has introduced WebAI, a new web standard that allows users to run AI models directly in its browser without relying on the cloud. This standard is designed to work with various AI models, including Google's Gemma and Apple's on-device foundation model.

stories.title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
stories.explanation: Nvidia has invested in Simplismart, an Indian startup that develops software to help companies run AI models more efficiently and with fewer GPUs. This investment addresses the challenge of economically running AI models at scale amidst the AI boom.

stories.title: 3 Ways to Boost MoE Inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark
stories.explanation: NVIDIA is detailing three techniques to boost Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference performance on NVIDIA DGX Spark, focusing on reducing weight traffic and generating more tokens per verification round. This aims to improve the speed of token generation for AI models.
